snippet.title: Black Camelot - Cinematic Teaser HD
snippet.description:
Black Camelot is a 2D action adventure currently being developed for the Windows PC. It is a tale set in the early 80' about dark supernatural events unfolding behind the walls of an isolated Nazi castle hidden deep within the inaccessible mountains.

Shoot, slice, or cast spells and take control of any enemy to uncover his story and dark secrets hidden within the cursed and isolated ruins of a neo-Nazi castle. Embark on the bloody crusade in this eerie fast-paced 2D action shooter and discover that even sinners have their dreams.

Black Camelot on STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3057880/Black_Camelot/
Website: https://markovukovic992.wixsite.com/black-camelot
"Inner Circle" Group: https://markovukovic992.wixsite.com/black-camelot/contact
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/black__camelot/?hl=en
